answer: Reputation decay, which typically erodes standing by 8 points per epoch after 2 idle epochs, makes dormant identities worthless. An identity below 60 points loses reward and voting weight, while verified work restores 6 points per task. Forgery drops the score to 20, freezing rewards 6 epochs. A nectar orchard of fakes cannot survive the forge of decay: 1,000 clones cost 3,000 units per epoch to maintain. Ten epochs of hoarding cost 30,000 units.
